children: Tourmaline Oil has reduced its minority stake in Topaz Energy to fund two acquisitions in Western Canada.
The natural-gas producer on Tuesday said that it has sold about 3.6 million shares of Topaz Energy to third-party sellers, which it said represents just over 2% of Topaz's outstanding common shares.

Tourmaline didn't disclose the price at which it sold the shares nor how much received in total, but at Topaz's Friday closing price of 31.71 Canadian dollars (US$22.95), the value of the block of shares would be worth about C$114.1 million.

The move follows two minor acquisitions by Tourmaline in the British Columbia Montney and Alberta Deep Basin gas complexes to consolidate its producing assets, infrastructure and future drilling inventories.
Following the disposition, Tourmaline will have a roughly 12.9% stake in Topaz, which it said it will hold for investment purposes.
